summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to upsize its existing at-the-market offering with WallachBeth Capital as sales agent, adding up to $3,428,226 of common stock beyond roughly $1.3 million already sold (114,672 shares) under the May 2025 sales agreement. The aggregate authorized program becomes up to $5,228,226. Shares trade on Nasdaq as BIAF at $2.91 as of October 30, 2026. The filing notes an S-3 I.B.6 one-third non-affiliate float cap, with non-affiliate market value near $27.7 million. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and ATM utilization.
